title: PCAA attestation package
description: The signed PCAA package the AFSP platform delivers to the receiving institution (§6.1), validated by VAL-01 to VAL-10 (§6.2). Before binding (Appendix A.6) the package carries no institution nonce; binding adds receiving_institution_id, institution_nonce, nonce_bound_institution and nonce_expiry (§6.1, §10.2 Step 2). Whether signals_present matches the signals carried, and the 3600 s / 1800 s limits, are checked by the verifier, not this schema.

receiving_institution_id.description: Institution identifier from the Participation Registry (VAL-02).

institution_nonce.description: Institution-bound session nonce, added at binding (VAL-04a).

nonce_bound_institution.description: Hash of the receiving institution's registered public key; reference proposal: its RFC 7638 thumbprint.

routing_destination.description: Set on an unbound package held for the reverse inquiry (Appendix A.6), e.g. AFSP_MARKETPLACE_REVERSE_INQUIRY.

validity_window.description: not_after at most 3600 s after not_before (§6.1, VAL-03).

signals.description: The five independently sourced trust signals (§6.1). S1, S2 and S4 are mandatory, S5 conditional and S3 optional (§3.3); an absent mandatory signal rejects the package at VAL-05, VAL-07 or VAL-09 rather than failing structure. S1 and S2 may arrive in another credential format named by a `format` member (e.g. AFSP-CREDENTIALS, reference proposals P5 and P6).

S5.description: The platform's signed composite (§11.3) or a single certified provider's submission (§11.2).
